dedupe_keys.name: wind measurements at the sand motor

description: TU Delft provides wind observations from a Sand Motor pole with six anemometers. The native heights above the bed are 0.179, 0.572, 0.962, 1.470, 1.985 and 2.480 metres. The custom time coverage spans 15 May 2015 to 6 April 2016. Coverage: 2015-05-15T00:00:00Z/2016-04-06T00:00:00Z. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Sensor height is not a map resolution or time step. Wind units, sampling interval, calibration and missing-record behaviour are unstated. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
